items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: I went to play with Mabel E. Lane in a New Orleans jazz band.

ctx.x: And then where did you go?
I went to play with Mabel E. Lane in a New Orleans jazz band.

Oh, you know, Louis Kepert was playing on it. I had Louis Kepert with me. Just recently, Louis Kepert got hit by a police car. Oh, yeah? Yeah, it could only happen to Louis Kepert. Oh, my goodness. You know, get hit by a police car. Oh. Is this seriously her? No, no, I think he can walk around and talk. He can still talk, I'll tell you that.
